column1: # The freeze audit's trust root (ADR 0027). One row per issue in the committed
# snapshot; docs/freeze-audit.md's classification table is GENERATED from this file
# by render-audit.sh and check-freeze-audit.sh fails if the two diverge. Do not edit
# the page's table by hand.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   number              bare issue number, no '#'
#   tracker_updated_at  the issue's updatedAt from the tracker, ISO 8601 UTC
#   what_it_is          the row's one-line description
#   surface             exactly one of the five frozen surfaces, or 'none':
#                         config-format | report-schema | exit-codes
#                         | replay-compatibility | mcp-surface | none
#   surface_reason      why that surface, or why none. Never empty.
#   class               A | B | C, on PASS-soundness grounds. Applies to every row,
#                       not only to touchers (owner ruling 2026-08-27; see the page's
#                       invariant section for why the two axes are separate).
#   disposition         fix | demote | narrow | measured-already-fixed | document
#                       | defer | tracked. Allowed values depend on class:
#                         A -> fix, demote, narrow, measured-already-fixed
#                         B -> fix, document
#                         C -> fix, defer, tracked
#   rationale           the prose that follows the disposition. May be empty for a
#                       bare 'defer' or 'tracked'; write '-' for none, never an
#                       empty trailing field (no other TSV here carries one).
